name: Uragiri no Netorase ~Kokoro made Otosarete Shimatta Saiaizuma Aina
original_name: 裏切りの寝取らせ ～心まで堕とされてしまった最愛妻・愛依奈
source:

He wants more intense stimulation, so he asks his wife if they can engage in more intimate sexual activities. They did so because they had faith in Shoji, and he was eager to help out—
